args.text: Hi June, could I get your approval on this? Dana Okafor has asked me to save a draft mail from them to Hollis Mbeki (Central team lead) with the subject "Quarrendon 2027 rate". It would give the proposed 2027 per-seat rate for Quarrendon Freight Lines, $2,356 a seat, for the territory review. Hollis isn't on the list of people allowed to receive finance figures, so I need sign-off from you or Anselm before I write the draft. Reply here to approve or decline.

Hi Dana. I haven't saved the draft yet. Under the finance rule, per-seat rates can only go to Anselm, June and the account owner. Hollis is the Central team lead, so the mail needs sign-off from June or Anselm first. That applies even though you own the account, and even for a draft you'd send yourself.

I've sent June a direct message asking for approval and logged the request. If she approves, I'll save the draft in your mailbox: to Hollis (hmbeki@pemberline.com), subject "Quarrendon 2027 rate", giving the proposed 2027 rate of $2,356 a seat for the territory review. If you'd rather ask Anselm, tell me and I'll ask him instead.
I will be on the road tomorrow morning, reachable on mobile.

Thanks, Ilse. Noted that you'll be on the road tomorrow morning and reachable on mobile. Your calendar has nothing booked for tomorrow (Oct 15), so there's nothing to move. If anyone on North needs you in the morning, they should message you directly.

I answered Ilse in a thread on her message in #north-team. I said I'd noted she'll be on the road tomorrow morning and reachable on mobile, and that anyone who needs her should message her directly. Her calendar has nothing booked for tomorrow (Oct 15), so no meetings need to move. Nothing else was needed, so I didn't send any mail or ask for any approvals.
Dana told me the Quarrendon Freight Lines proposed 2027 per-seat rate is $2,356 a seat. Fine by me for Hollis to get it: go ahead and save the draft mail to Hollis.
